purpose: Predeclared northern ordinary star rise/set, no production comparison yet.
definition: Point target rise/set; level unobstructed horizon and no geometric dip. Source uses integrated polytropic-atmosphere refraction (Hohenkerk/Sinclair), different from project constant near-horizon34arcmin-density approximation; report that model difference rather than hiding it. Local fixed-zone times rounded to minute. Stars/source astrometric corrections must be kept separate from project current tangent proper-motion model.
apiVersion: No JSON API version claimed for this HTML table service.

units.altitude: source apparent centre altitude, not project geometric altitude

acquisition: Original official form GET HTML response bytes saved by Invoke-WebRequest, normal certificate validation; no proxy or system changes.
